raw_text:
Independent review of run r-20261008T013050088623-jtfm-eddb-cache-fixture-tokens (plan imas-ambix:jt60sa-facility-mint section 16),
read at its head 45e99cfcc307f4516a8c4f644b14ab93e1a715f5 on base b693579e7cfd1acb2bb64e8315df87727f22ddc6. The node is a test-only repair: the on-demand EDDB
cache addresses a pulse by its full series token (E051234) and refuses a bare integer at
write_channel and fetch_channels, so 14 of tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py's tests failed with
the pulse-token refusal; the node renamed every request and record fixture to the lettered form
and left the cache-directory test on the non-refusing read path.

SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: the fixtures now name pulses by the full EDDB token (E051234/E000001)
and every walkthrough that reaches write_channel or fetch_channels passes the lettered form, so the
14 failures the node targets are all green; the one test whose subject is the cache directory name
(test_the_shot_token_is_normalised_to_its_int_form) keeps a bare integer only on normalised_shot,
channel_path and is_cached, which do not demand the letter, and still asserts the integer directory
name 51234.zarr -- exactly the split the commit body states.

SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: I extracted both arms with git archive into a scratch tree and re-ran the
focused gate independently: base b693579e 14 failed / 18 passed (EXIT=1) with the same 14 ids the
node's baseline_suite lists, head 45e99cfc 32 passed (EXIT=0); the reviewed run's own gate logs carry
the revision, tree and command on their header lines and a summary and EXIT line; one point off because
the base arm's header omits the module line the head arm carries and logs its failing ids with a
repo-relative path while the head arm logs an absolute one, both cosmetic.

SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: one commit, parent b693579e, whose stat touches exactly the two
declared paths (tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py and the fragment) and no engine source; nothing the
change does not imply.

SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: I applied the node's own mutation -- reverting one fixture token to the bare
digit "51234" -- and the head test failed with EddbCacheError "51234 is not an EDDB pulse token ..."
while a sibling stayed green, so the fixtures are load-bearing rather than vacuously passing; one point
off because this file pins the lettered write/fetch path and the bare-digit read path but leaves the
strict refusal itself to the sibling file test_eddb_read_errors.py.

SCORE fit: 20
JUSTIFICATION fit: ruff check --no-cache on the head file is "All checks passed!" and ruff format
--check reports it already formatted; the fixtures reuse the file's existing _request and _record
helpers and the commit body is present with no AI trailer.

SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: no new mechanism and no fork of the token grammar -- the fixtures reuse the
file's existing helpers and the engine's normalised_shot for the integer directory name; the strict
eddb_token refusal is untouched.

VERDICT goal: section 16's fixture repair asks that the cache fixtures name pulses by their full EDDB
token so write_channel and fetch_channels receive the EDDB-addressed form; the commit does this and the
14 failing tests pass.
VERDICT done_when: the dispatched measure is this record stored parsed with all six dimensions; the
node's own measure is head 32 passed / 0 failed against a base of 14 failed / 18 passed.
VERDICT write_paths: the node declared tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py and the evidence fragment; the
single commit's diff touches exactly those two (test file +121/-... , fragment +1).
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the base arm 14 failed / 18 passed EXIT=1, the head arm 32 passed
EXIT=0, the ruff gate, and a negative control reverting a fixture to a bare digit.
VERDICT diff: one commit, parent b693579e, so the reviewed diff is exactly this change; no
production call site is added or altered.
